name: Mushroom "Cheesesteaks" with Quick-Pickled Pepper Salad
instructions: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler. Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Remove mushroom stems and carefully scrape out the gills, place mushroom caps on one half of the baking sheet.

Seed and slice bell peppers into thin strips; place on the other half of the baking sheet. Drizzle the veggies with oil and season with salt and pepper. Place in the oven and broil, until veggies are soft and lightly charred around the edges, 4-5 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, coarsely grate cheese and set aside.
Combine vinegar, oil, honey, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Transfer the cooked peppers to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine; set aside.
Whisk together flour, spices, and half of the milk in a medium saucepan. Heat over medium, whisking frequently, until thick, 1-2 minutes. Pour in remaining milk and whisk to combine.
Once the milk is steaming, remove from heat, and add the cheese. Continue whisking until the cheese has melted, creating a thick sauce, 2-3 minutes; set aside.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl with the peppers and stir to combine.
Split and toast the buns, if desired.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Fill buns with mushrooms and drizzle with cheese sauce.
To serve, divide "cheesesteaks" and mixed greens between plates. Top greens with roasted peppers and dressing. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
